title: Placement with an exact selector
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $l$, a placement consists of an injective map from the $k$ positions to the $l$ positions and a selector assigning to each of the $l$ positions either no position or one of the $k$ positions. The selector returns position $i$ at position $j$ exactly when the injective map sends $i$ to $j$.
